contexts.name: FederationManagement

metadata.specification: Organization Name Unique
metadata.rule: Organization names must be unique.

elements.name: Approve Invited Participant

metadata.specification: Only Invited Active Organizations Join Federation
metadata.rule: A participant can join only after the organization is active and has an outstanding invitation for the target federation.

elements.name: Reject Uninvited Participant Approval

metadata.rule: A participant can join only after the organization is active and has an outstanding invitation for the target federation.

elements.name: Reject Approval Before Contract Validation

metadata.rule: A dataset can be approved only after contract validation succeeds and the validation profile reports acceptable quality and schema compatibility.

elements.name: Block Violating Access Profile

metadata.specification: Blocked Dataset Access Cannot Be Used For Training
metadata.rule: A blocked dataset access profile must not be selected by any future training job or node participation request.

elements.name: Reject Draft Training Job Submission

metadata.rule: A training job can be submitted only after its training strategy has been configured.

elements.name: Start Round With Ready Node Quorum

elements.id: domain/FederationLearningPlatform/context/TrainingOrchestration/slice/StartTrainingRound/gwt/Training Round Requires Ready Node Quorum/Reject Round Start Below Quorum
elements.name: Reject Round Start Below Quorum

metadata.specification: Training Round Requires Ready Node Quorum
metadata.rule: A training round can start only when the ready node count satisfies the configured minimum node quorum for the training job.

elements.id: domain/FederationLearningPlatform/context/TrainingOrchestration/slice/RejectPoisonedLocalUpdate/gwt/Poisoned Local Updates Are Excluded/Reject Anomalous Update
elements.name: Reject Anomalous Update

metadata.specification: Poisoned Local Updates Are Excluded
metadata.rule: A local model update with an anomaly score above the configured policy threshold must be rejected and excluded from secure aggregation quorum counts.

elements.id: domain/FederationLearningPlatform/context/TrainingOrchestration/slice/CompleteTrainingRound/gwt/Training Round Completion Requires Global Evaluation/Complete Round After Global Evaluation
elements.name: Complete Round After Global Evaluation

metadata.specification: Training Round Completion Requires Global Evaluation
metadata.rule: A training round can be completed only after the aggregated global model has been evaluated.

elements.id: domain/FederationLearningPlatform/context/TrainingOrchestration/slice/CompleteTrainingRound/gwt/Training Round Completion Requires Global Evaluation/Reject Round Completion Without Global Evaluation
elements.name: Reject Round Completion Without Global Evaluation

metadata.specification: Training Round Completion Requires Global Evaluation
metadata.rule: A training round can be completed only after the aggregated global model has been evaluated.

notes: Training orchestration owns job intent, trusted runtime agents, and each round of distributed training and evaluation.
risks: Training can stall when ready nodes fall below quorum or when secure aggregation is requested before enough evaluated updates exist.
Poisoned local updates can degrade the global model if anomaly checks are not modeled as a first class decision.

metadata.rule: A model version can be promoted to production only after governance approval.

elements.id: domain/FederationLearningPlatform/context/ModelLifecycle/slice/PromoteModelToProduction/gwt/Only Approved Models Can Be Promoted To Production/Reject Unapproved Model Promotion
elements.name: Reject Unapproved Model Promotion

metadata.specification: Only Approved Models Can Be Promoted To Production
metadata.rule: A model version can be promoted to production only after governance approval.

contexts.name: RuntimeOperations
notes: Runtime operations separates heartbeat monitoring, training alerts, and append only audit records.
risks: Operational alerts without acknowledgement or resolution tracking can hide node degradation during training.
Audit records without payload hashes and source event classification weaken compliance evidence.

contexts.name: KeyAndAttestationManagement

elements.id: domain/FederationLearningPlatform/context/KeyAndAttestationManagement/slice/QuarantineNodeAfterAttestationFailure/gwt/Revoked Attestation Quarantines Node/Quarantine Revoked Attestation Node
elements.name: Quarantine Revoked Attestation Node

metadata.specification: Revoked Attestation Quarantines Node
metadata.rule: Nodes with revoked attestation reports must be quarantined before they can be considered for future training participation.

notes: Key and attestation management owns node attestation reports, secure aggregation key material, and dataset access credentials, replacing ad hoc cryptography fields scattered across other contexts.
risks: Expired attestation or revoked key material can allow an unsafe node to continue participating in training.
Secure aggregation key compromise can expose participant updates or invalidate aggregation results.

contexts.name: RuntimeAgentOperations
notes: Runtime agent operations is a separate deployable that runs inside participant infrastructure and executes dispatched training jobs with local data and local secrets.
risks: Agent jobs can leak local credentials if secret references are materialized outside the participant boundary.
GemiFL runtime jobs can remain running after platform cancellation unless local job lifecycle is tracked explicitly.
